## Account scopes [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#account-scopes)

The following are the available **Account** scopes and their associated API calls:

### account:master [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#accountmaster)

View and manage sub accounts

##### Associated API [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#associated-api)

- [Update the account owner](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/UpdateTheAccountOwner)
- [Get sub account details](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/GetSubAccountDetails)
- [List upcoming renewal accounts](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/Getupcomingrenewalaccounts)
- [List sub accounts](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accounts)
- [Create a sub account](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountCreate)
- [Update options](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/UpdateOptions)
- [Get account subscriptions usage](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetMsqPlanUsage)
- [Update meeting Waiting Room branding](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountMeetingWaitingRoomBrandingUpdate)
- [Get account's managed domains](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountManagedDomain)
- [Delete virtual background files](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/delVB)
- [Get plan usage](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetPlanUsage)
- [Get account's trusted domains](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountTrustedDomain)
- [Disassociate a sub account](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/DisassociateASubAccount)
- [Upload virtual background files](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/uploadVB)

### account:read:admin [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#accountreadadmin)

View account info

##### Associated API [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#associated-api-1)

- [Get indicators settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/iq/methods/#operation/accountIndicatorsSettings)
- [Get an account's webinar registration settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountSettingsRegistration)
- [Get account's managed domains](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/methods/#operation/accountManagedDomain)
- [Get locked settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/getAccountLockSettings)
- [Get account's trusted domains](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/methods/#operation/accountTrustedDomain)
- [Get indicators settings \[Deprecated\]](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/iq/methods/#operation/accountSettingsIndicatorsDeprecated)
- [Get account settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountSettings)

### account:write:admin [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#accountwriteadmin)

View and manage account info

##### Associated API [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#associated-api-2)

- [Update account settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountSettingsUpdate)
- [Get indicators settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/iq/methods/#operation/accountIndicatorsSettings)
- [Update the account owner](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/methods/#operation/UpdateTheAccountOwner)
- [Upload virtual background files](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/uploadVB)
- [Get indicators settings \[Deprecated\]](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/iq/methods/#operation/accountSettingsIndicatorsDeprecated)
- [Get account settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountSettings)
- [Update locked settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/UpdateLockedSettings)
- [Update meeting Waiting Room branding](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountMeetingWaitingRoomBrandingUpdate)
- [Update webinar Waiting Room branding](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/methods/#operation/UpdatewebinarWaitingRoombranding)
- [Get locked settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/getAccountLockSettings)
- [Get an account's webinar registration settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountSettingsRegistration)
- [Delete virtual background files](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/delVB)
- [Update an account's webinar registration settings](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/account/ma/#operation/accountSettingsRegistrationUpdate)

## Billing scopes [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#billing-scopes)

The following are the available **Billing** scopes and their associated API calls:

### billing:master [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#billingmaster)

View and manage sub account's billing info

##### Associated API [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#associated-api-3)

- [Subscribe an account to a plan](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/SubscribeAccountToAPlan)
- [Get invoice details](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetInvoiceDetails)
- [Cancel additional plans](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/CancelAdditionalPlans)
- [Generate sub accounts' billing invoice reports](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/generateSubInvoiceReport)
- [Get billing information](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetBillingInformation)
- [Delete subaccounts' billing invoice report](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/deleteBillingInvoiceReport)
- [Subscribe subaccount to an additional plan](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/SubscribeAccountToAnAdditionalPlan)
- [Update an account's additional plan](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/UpdateAnAccount'sAdditionalPlan)
- [Get plan usage](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetPlanUsage)
- [Download an invoice file](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/downloadInvoicePDF)
- [Update a base plan](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/UpdateABasePlan)
- [List upcoming renewal accounts](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/Getupcomingrenewalaccounts)
- [List billing invoices](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/ListBillingInvoices)
- [List sub accounts' billing invoice reports](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/listSubInvoiceReport)
- [Download subaccounts' billing invoice reports](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/downloadBillingInvoiceReport)
- [Download an invoice file (v2)](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/downloadInvoicePDFFile)
- [Cancel a base plan](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/CancelABasePlan)
- [Get account plan information](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetAccountPlanInformation)
- [Get account subscriptions usage](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/GetMsqPlanUsage)
- [Update billing information](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/billing/ma/#operation/UpdateBillingInformation)

## Calendar scopes [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#calendar-scopes)

The following are the available **Calendar** scopes and their associated API calls:

### calendar:read [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#calendarread)

View calendar

##### Associated API [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#associated-api-4)

- [Get the specified user calendar settings of the authenticated user](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Getsetting)
- [Get the color definitions for calendars and events](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Getcolor)
- [Query freebusy information for a set of calendars](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Queryfreebusy)
- [List ACL rules of specified calendar](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Listacl)
- [List all user calendar settings of the authenticated user](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Listsettings)
- [Get a specified calendar from the user's own calendarList](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/GetcalendarList)
- [Get the specified event on the specified calendar](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Getevent)
- [List events on the specified calendar](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Listevent)
- [List the calendars in the user's own calendarList](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/ListcalendarList)
- [Get the specified calendar](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Getcalendar)
- [List all instances of the specified recurring event](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Instanceevent)
- [Get the specified ACL rule](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-calendar/methods/#operation/Getacl)

### calendar:read:admin [\#](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes/\#calendarreadadmin)

View calendar
